visual_action: A montage shows clips of Donald Trump with Supreme Court Justices Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, and Amy Coney Barrett during their appointments and swearing-in ceremonies. A red text box is overlaid for the entire duration of the video.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in multiple clips with the justices he appointed and is explicitly named in the on-screen text: 'Trump appointed three justices...'

cast.name: Neil Gorsuch
cast.evidence: He is shown with Donald Trump and being sworn in. He is one of the 'three justices' mentioned in the on-screen text.

cast.name: Brett Kavanaugh
cast.evidence: He is shown interacting with Donald Trump. He is one of the 'three justices' mentioned in the on-screen text.

cast.name: Amy Coney Barrett
cast.evidence: She is shown walking with Donald Trump and being sworn in. She is one of the 'three justices' mentioned in the on-screen text.

on_screen_text.text: This is your reminder that Trump appointed three justices who overturned Roe v. Wade

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video.
audio_music: A classical music piece, identified as an excerpt from Tchaikovsky's 'Swan Lake,' plays throughout. Layered over it is a high-pitched, continuous screaming or screeching sound effect, creating an ominous and alarming tone.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between different clips.
cultural_references: The music is from the famous ballet 'Swan Lake' by Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky.
central_claim: Donald Trump is directly responsible for the overturning of Roe v. Wade because he appointed the three Supreme Court justices who made it possible.
intended_effect: To remind viewers of the consequences of Donald Trump's presidency regarding abortion rights, thereby generating opposition to him.
